Nine slots for sub-kinds 0..8. CWnd::m_hWnd sits at +0x20, so slots 6, 7 and 8 are the windows of the CMyProgress instances at this+0x140528, this+0x1405B0 and this+0x140638 - exactly the three the render routine reads through CMyProgress_GetValueRange for the Skill (Progress42), MP and HP gauge sub-kinds. Slot index and gauge index therefore agree independently.

The only other writer of these arrays is sub_5DB954, which repeats the same nine stores with the same -0x14 Y adjustment (established by scanning .text for every displacement in the 0x1796A4..0x1796E8 range).
